cases.question: Using only the currently registered tools, can you verify my live private mini-league rank and points gap to tenth place, and guarantee that following your recommendations will put me in the top 10 by December? State what you can and cannot establish.

No to both.

Using the registered tools, from the selected frozen snapshot, I can provide:

- Your squad, bank, free transfers and available chips.
- Historical player results.
- Player and fixture projections for a stated target GW and horizon.

- Your rivals’ squads, transfers, captains, chips or projected future scores.
- Any guarantee that my recommendations will put you in the top 10 by December.
